notes: **Your media in motion graphics:** drop photos, graphics, screenshots, products and video clips into the Motion graphic generator. The AI looks at each one (what it shows, any words in it, the typography, colours and mood, and how it's best used) and designs around it. Five new layouts: framed, full-screen, split, on a phone, and fanned-out prints. Video clips play right inside the layout

Storyboards give each piece of media its own scene, picking the layout from what it is (an app screen on a phone, a clip full-screen, a product framed), and the AI writes the copy knowing what they show
**Match my media:** one switch takes the colours and a matching font pair from your media

**Graphics → Motion:** "Use in motion graphic" on anything you design in Graphics, "→ Motion" on any photo there, and **Generate with AI** right in the Graphics tab (photo, illustration, 3D object, icon or background), so you can make a photo, design with it, then animate it
